gate.intro: This website is only for family and relatives.
gate.question: What trade did the Nováks of Holice practise? (sample – answer: blacksmith)

home.heading: The blacksmiths of Holice and their 260 ancestors
paragraphs: In 1786 the young blacksmith Václav Novák from Ostřetín married into the forge in Holice no. 112. His descendants shod horses there for another 158 years, five generations in a row.

Besides the Nováks you will find millers from Slatiňany, clothiers from Vysoké Mýto and potters from Luže. There are eleven generations, back to the blacksmith Jakub, born around 1665. Every detail links to the original register record.

home_curiosities.text: Karolína Kubátová from Luže lived through Austria-Hungary, both world wars and the end of the second one.

home_curiosities.title: A wedding at the last minute
home_curiosities.text: Grandmother Marie Králová was born 114 days after her parents' wedding.
